credibility.why: Unit, regression and lint suites; deterministic replay; envelope maths tested.
Held-out real X500 flights, but referent is onboard EKF2, not independent truth.
Public user-uploaded logs, deduplicated and quality-gated; payloads and props unknown.
Per-speed-band 95% envelopes with held-out coverage; wind term is modelled.
Five vehicle-grouped folds; fast flight and strong wind are sparse.
No operational use yet; own RTK + anemometer flights would raise this.

limits: Absolute touchdown accuracy for your aircraft in real wind (no public X500 data with measured wind).
Gust response: wind term is modelled from identified dynamics, not validated against measured wind.
GNSS-outage behaviour beyond PX4's documented failsafe logic.
Speeds above 3.3 m/s: few public X500 Offboard flights exist.
